classification_rules: Only official or publisher-authored pages corroborate affiliation relations; exact-name cross-listing in unrelated Swedish sources is recorded as an unresolved lead, not merged onto the SIPRI person.

Exact-name match only; identity with the SIPRI staff member is unconfirmed and was not merged.

Municipal government body and party listings; exact-name match only, identity with the SIPRI staff member unconfirmed.
findings.name: Sundbyberg municipal and party roles (non-dark-academia)

findings.detail: Bounded web discovery surfaced no other dark-academia component organization, company board, government body, or advisory group publicly listing IngMarie Bohmelin.
